scope: Read-only source, BUILDING_KIT.md, isolated exported contact sheet and manifest review of the 50-part building kit; requested report is the only review-authored file.

nominal_fit.bottom_centered_source_origins: All 50 source factories checked within 1e-8 m tolerance

example_scene.reason: 4 m wall ends join 0.2 m pier bodies; floor/ceiling interior edges meet wall inner faces. Window origin equals floor top plus 0.9 m sill; ceiling equals wall origin plus 3 m.

findings.issue: Coplanar wall corner trim and floor fascia exterior surfaces
findings.resolution: Root removed overlapping corner trim and moved fascia front beyond the body face while burying its back.

findings.issue: 17.5 mm open perimeter around window glass
findings.resolution: Root increased glass extent to overlap invisibly into frame/mullions.

findings.issue: 64 mm open strip above glazed door midrail
findings.resolution: Root computes glass endpoints from rail positions with small buried overlaps.
Root widened leaves to 0.946 m at centres±.475m, giving 4 mm nominal meeting clearance.

findings.issue: Ceiling perimeter bars exceeded 2 m/4 m tiling footprint by 24 mm
findings.resolution: Root uses half-width perimeter bars inset 0.006 m. Fresh source bounds confirm exact 2/4 m dimensions.

findings.issue: Clerestory insert has no standard 1.4 m wall socket
findings.resolution: BUILDING_KIT.md explicitly identifies2×.6m clerestory as a custom-opening insert.
Root mirrors all right-leaf vertices about the leaf centre and reverses new face winding, placing hinges at the outer jamb and handles at the meeting edge.

findings.issue: Storefront side glazing lacks bottom closure and stops 15 mm below header
findings.resolution: Root extends side glass over z = 0.04–2.56 m and adds 0.05 m bottom rails, providing 0.01 m buried overlap at bottom and header.
